lines.x: The Central Bank of Egypt raised its benchmark interest rate for the first time in nearly three years, despite easing inflation.
The war on Iran doubled Egypt's liquefied natural gas import bill as domestic gas output fell to 3.63 billion cubic feet per day in August, forcing Cairo to defer cargoes and burn fuel oil.
Banque du Caire began trading on the Egyptian Exchange following the country's largest share sale ever, which raised US$657 million for a 45% stake in the state-owned bank.
The United States has signed a five-year, $625 million economic agreement with Egypt.
